source_caption: In Eat Pray Love (2010) Julia Roberts truly embraced the spirit of the film’s first act, during the "Eat" portion of the film shot in Italy, she famously refused to use spit buckets or fake food because she wanted the scenes to look authentic. She later shared in interviews that she ate entire pizzas and multiple plates of pasta during single shoots, resulting in her gaining around 10 pounds by the time she left Rome to film the remaining acts in India and Bali.
